title: Little City Home
description: A smart, welcoming home where every corner earns its place without feeling crowded.

cover.alt: Cartoon-style concept illustration of a compact apartment with wood storage, a terracotta sofa, and a window-side dining nook; not a photograph

gallery.alt: Cartoon apartment entry with built-in storage, a cushioned bench, mirror, and wall hooks
gallery.title: An entry that works harder
gallery.description: A bench, tall shelving, and wall hooks gather everyday belongings in one compact zone so the rest of the home can stay uncluttered.

gallery.alt: Cartoon compact kitchen with fitted cabinets, pale counters, and a small preparation station
gallery.title: A compact cooking space
gallery.description: Fitted storage and clear work surfaces explore how a small kitchen can feel useful and welcoming rather than crowded.

gallery.alt: Cartoon compact bedroom with a fitted wardrobe, pale bedding, and a small bedside table
gallery.title: A neatly organized bedroom
gallery.description: A fitted wardrobe and modest bedside furniture keep storage close at hand while preserving a calm, simple resting space.

gallery.alt: Cartoon window-side workspace with a laptop desk, bookcase, green chair, and low bench
gallery.title: A window-side work nook
gallery.description: A slim desk uses window light for focused work, with vertical shelving and a low bench making the surrounding corner useful.

gallery.alt: Cartoon apartment dining nook with a small wood table, muted chairs, and pendant lighting
gallery.title: Room for everyday meals
gallery.description: A small table and neatly arranged seating establish a dedicated meal zone without overwhelming the apartment's living space.
